heroLede: Colour drift and registration errors found after the run cost paper, ink and press time. Here's what a camera check could look like at the delivery of your press. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every sheet is in register, with each colour sitting where it should. A sheet a fraction out of register is easy to miss by eye at full speed.
labelLede: Colour drift, hickeys, streaks and missing text are easy to miss during a long run. The camera compares every sheet with the approved first sheet your operator signs off.
codeLede: Where your sheets carry job and sheet marks, the system reads them on every sheet, so the wrong plate or an old version of the artwork shows up straight away.
objectLede: Paper offcuts and loose items can end up in the delivery pile. The camera spots anything that should not be there before sheets go to finishing.

vocab.ok: Register, print and job mark OK
